questions.question: Six students Lovely, Johnson, Will, Marie, Samantha and Joel are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Lovely is sitting second to the left of Johnson. Will is sitting second to the right of Johnson. Samantha is sitting third to the left of Will. Joel is sitting third to the right of Johnson. Marie is the immediate neighbour of Will and Johnson. Who is sitting between Lovely and Johnson?
questions.solution:
Given: Six students Lovely, Johnson, Will, Marie, Samantha and Joel are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Lovely is sitting second to the left of Johnson.

2) Will is sitting second to the right of Johnson.

3) Samantha is sitting third to the left of Will.

4) Joel is sitting third to the right of Johnson.

5) Marie is the immediate neighbour of Will and Johnson.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc636d7d12b4d856846453d0cf05347e02321378a98d2c20e921f2185b3a46d9.png] 

Here, 'Samantha' is sitting between Lovely and Johnson.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Wheel : Cart :: Nib : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The first word is the **component and**** **the second word is** ****its function**.

Here,

Wheel : Cart → **Wheel **is a component of a **Cart**.

Similarly,

Nib : Pen → **Nib **is a component of a **Pen**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

and ‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

How is Q related to N if N - D × P + Q & C?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Brother
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: N - D × P + Q & C

It means: N is the Father of D, D is the Brother of P, P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Sister of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8bee0dbfe8ab42e5e2db4056642699b41e3331ff92479b8eb164e3af175eb39.png] 

So, 'Q' is Daughter’s daughter of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

B is at one end of the row. H is seated adjacent to both F and G. F is at the third place to the left of B. A is sitting to the immediate left of F. All these nine students are facing the north direction. who is sitting in between D and A?
questions.solution:

Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

India : New Delhi :: Australia : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second word is the capital of the first word.

Here,

India : New Delhi → **New Delhi** is the capital of **India**.

Similarly,

Australia : Canberra → Canberra is the capital of Australia.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pen is a box.

Some pens are chalks.

All chalks are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are pens.

II. Some chalks are not boxes.

III. Some boxes are not erasers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

No pen is a box.

Some pens are chalks.

All chalks are erasers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4b9c0b9ed8089f019f6000bf3f3f60fe519aece22bee242b4a4b96d934642e1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are pens - True (Because, Those erasers that is chalks will pen also).

II. Some chalks are not boxes - True (Because, Those part of Chalks that is pen will also not boxes).

III. Some boxes are not erasers - False (__It may or may not be true cause it can also consider the part of pen which does not include eraser. So, it is indefinite conclusion__).

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in an English dictionary.

1. SPINY

2. SPINE

3. SPINACH

4. SPINNEY

5. SPIRIT

6. SPIKE
questions.solution:
The correct dictionary order for the give words are:

6. SPI__**K**__E 

3. SPI__**NA**__CH

2. SPI__**NE**__

4. SPI__**NN**__EY

1. SPI__**NY**__

5. SPI__**R**__IT

So, the correct sequence is '6, 3, 2, 4, 1, 5'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
